init_BaseRoIHead: create a BaseRoIHead instance with bbox_head, mask_head, and shared_head configurations
init_weights_BaseRoIHead: initialize the weights in the RoI head using pretrained model weights
forward_train_BaseRoIHead: run the forward training pass with proposals, ground truth bboxes, and labels
simple_test_BaseRoIHead: test the RoI head without augmentation using proposals and image metadata
aug_test_BaseRoIHead: test the RoI head with augmentations and optional result rescaling
